_comment: objective.type: kill (target = enemy id) or fetch (target = item id, taken on turn-in). reward: item/count, coins, ability (from abilities.json). Text may use {n} and {count}.

rat_problem.title: Rat Problem
rat_problem.intro: Rats! They chew through my rope and my rations. Thin them out for me - three should teach the rest a lesson.
rat_problem.accepted: Good. They skulk about in the big chamber below.
rat_problem.complete: Ha! That'll teach 'em. Here - my spare boots. They grip the slick moss down in the Hollow.

old_bones.title: Old Bones
old_bones.intro: I collect old bones. Don't ask why. Bring me three and I'll teach you a miner's trick for lasting longer down there.
old_bones.accepted: Rats drag them about. Have a look.
old_bones.complete: Lovely. Now breathe deep, like this... hold it... There. You'll last longer down there.
